summary: Master sustainable and green procurement. Learn ISO 20400, LCA, and Scope 3 reporting to drive ESG impact and supply chain resilience. Enroll at TrainingCred.
lede: Green procurement training helps sourcing and supplier-management professionals integrate environmental and social factors into purchasing decisions. They practise prioritizing categories, assessing life-cycle costs and supplier emissions evidence, setting tender criteria and contract measures, and reviewing supplier performance, using ISO 20400 and the GHG Protocol as references.
audienceIntro: This advanced sustainable procurement course is designed for professionals who already manage sourcing, supplier relationships, sustainability data, or procurement governance and now need to embed measurable environmental and social criteria into commercial decisions.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, category management, supplier management, sustainability, or supply-chain risk. Working knowledge of sourcing processes, spend data, supplier contracts, and basic spreadsheet analysis is expected. No programming is required. Advanced analytics and AI-assisted procurement tools are covered at operational application level, while participants practise structured analysis using provided datasets and templates.
